name: spice-boiler-thermostat-gpt-6-astra-s3-r1-v2
prompt: Model an espresso machine's boiler in ngspice as an electrical analogue (heater, thermal mass, heat loss) with a thermostat that holds it between 92 and 96 °C, and simulate the first 20 minutes from cold. In a .control block, save the boiler temperature with wrdata to a .txt file so it can be plotted.

source.text:
Espresso boiler - 1200 W heater, 92 to 96 degC thermostat
*
* Lumped thermal analogue (no water draw during warm-up/idle):
*   1 V = 1 degC; 1 A = 1 W; 1 F = 1 J/K; 1 ohm = 1 K/W.
* Effective heat capacity: 2500 J/K (water plus boiler metal).
* Ambient/cold start: 20 degC. Heat loss: 2 W/K to ambient.
* Energy balance: 2500*dT/dt = heater_power - (T - 20)/0.5.
*
Vambient ambient 0 DC 20
Cthermal boiler 0 2500 IC=20
Rloss boiler ambient 0.5
*
* Ideal 1200 W heater injects heat into the thermal capacitance.
* The low-power control circuit below is not part of the thermal mass.
Bheater 0 boiler I={1200*(v(heater_on)>0.5)}
*
* Hysteretic thermostat: control voltage = 94 - boiler temperature.
* Switch ON above +2 V (T < 92), OFF below -2 V (T > 96).
* Between thresholds it retains its previous state. Starts ON when cold.
Vlogic logic 0 DC 1
Vset setpoint 0 DC 94
Sthermostat logic heater_on setpoint boiler thermostat ON
Rlogic heater_on 0 1000
.model thermostat SW(Ron=0.001 Roff=1e12 Vt=0 Vh=2)
*
.options reltol=1e-5 abstol=1e-9 vntol=1e-6 trtol=1
.control
set noaskquit
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
* 1200 seconds = first 20 minutes. UIC preserves the cold-start IC.
* Maximum step 0.05 s resolves thermostat switching to about 0.02 degC.
tran 0.1 1200 0 0.05 uic
* Two columns: time in seconds, absolute boiler temperature in degC.
wrdata boiler_temperature.txt v(boiler)
.endc
.end
